name: MT200 CY PIE (blue + red, red delayed 4 ns)
source: From SymPhoTime 64 2.8's CY_PIE.pus on the MT200 PC FK03-PC-PC118 (desktop shortcut, 2026-10-28). Sync divider: not in the .pus; at the 40 MHz sync the HydraHarp 400 needs at least 4 (measured). Detectors on HydraHarp inputs 1 and 3 (phacq inputs 0 and 2). SymPhoTime pulse mode 1 (PIE); laser head 2 (red) delay 4.0 ns. TCSPC settings are the same in every MT200 profile: 32 ps bins (binning 5, as in the PIE profiles), sync CFD 350 mV / offset 5000 ps, detectors 250 mV with their offsets (input 0: +130 ps from PIE.pus, input 2: -40 ps from Standard.pus).

laser.pie_note: The SOM-D's PIE sequence for this profile has not been recorded yet; record it when SymPhoTime applies PIE.pus.
